scope: ctaguchi/parakeet-hf-ctc-110m-en ONNX export plus a real-audio ORT run. The library-side port is NOT done: no preset, no feature extractor and no decoding family exist yet.

graph_runtime_check.note: Shape evidence only; no transcript or oracle comparison yet.
